en: Black‑and‑white landscape view taken from a wooded lookout with a simple wooden railing in the foreground. Below is a densely forested valley; in the mid‑distance stands a large multi‑arched stone railway viaduct, and beyond it a town with a church spire and factory chimney against low hills. Printed German text at the top identifies the scene as a view over the Lützeltal valley from the Emilientempel near Frankenberg in Saxony.
